name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's career in motorsport security began somewhat unconventionally. After serving in the Japanese Self-Defense Forces specializing in counter-terrorism, he sought a new challenge that utilized his strategic thinking and risk assessment skills. A chance encounter with a race team owner at a charity event led to an introduction to the world of motorsports security, and he quickly rose through the ranks. 

Kenji's approach is meticulous and proactive. He believes in not just reacting to threats but anticipating them, using data analysis and advanced surveillance techniques to identify potential vulnerabilities. His dedication to detail, combined with a surprisingly creative approach to problem-solving, makes him a highly effective security chief. He is deeply loyal to Cool Racing, viewing the team as his family and fiercely protective of its members and assets.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height, Kenji has a serious demeanor, reflecting his commitment to security.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of 'The Art of War'
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses, even when they appear spotless
Insists on brewing his own green tea every afternoon at precisely 3 PM
